faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIM Kozhikode Admin. Associate recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Admin. Associate post at IIM Kozhikode is 06 September 2026. Ensure you complete the process before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Admin. Associate position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Masters' or Bachelors' degree in any subject. Additionally, 1-2 years of relevant administrative experience is required.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Admin. Associate role?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Admin. Associate position is 35 years. Please refer to the official notification for any age relaxation details.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Admin. Associate post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Admin. Associate position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 27,800 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the IIM Kozhikode Admin. Associate job?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted online through the official website of IIM Kozhikode or via the direct application link provided in the 'Important Links' section.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee for this recruitment drive. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for confirmation.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Admin. Associate position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Admin. Associate role will involve a screening of applications followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Admin. Associate position is a contract-based job at IIM Kozhikode.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the 'Important Links' section of this article. It contains all detailed information about the recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of IIM Kozhikode?
faq.answer: The official website of Indian Institute of Management Kozhikode is https://iimk.ac.in/. You can visit it for more information about the institute and its activities.
